title: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ formalize-first unified typeclass — `BarEvenKernel` bundles all four $\S 4$ invariants (bar-even, radius-of-convergence, q=1 shadow, direction sanity) into one parametric Lean typeclass so any future kernel candidate $F(q)$ becomes a single class-instance attempt
html:
Proposition. \mathfrak{Q}_\beta formalize-first unified typeclass — BarEvenKernel bundles all four \S 4 invariants (bar-even, radius-of-convergence, q=1 shadow, direction sanity) into one parametric Lean typeclass so any future kernel candidate F(q) becomes a single class-instance attempt

The BarEvenKernel Lean typeclass bundles all four formalize-first invariants for F(q) into a single parametric type. Instantiating BarEvenKernel is equivalent to clearing all four gates simultaneously.

This bundles the anchor-stable, bar-even, q=1 shadow, and direction-sanity checks into a single step for Lean. It operationalises the pre-flight checklist. The bar-even invariant is a structural identity in CommRing R. The composition theorem lifts the bundle into the individual gate classes.
